payload.summary: Validated RI03 at 52f25814: 478 deterministic tests pass, contract and structural gates are green, and two independent implementation reviews converged with no blocker. Thirteen live-resource cases remain explicitly deferred before production enablement.
completed_work: Passed 478 deterministic tests: 277 package, 100 coordinator, 71 bridge, and 30 OpenAPI contract cases.
Passed project-scoped mypy, changed-file Ruff, strict OpenSpec, work-package schema/DAG/zones, architecture-flow, review-schema, and diff-hygiene gates.
Resolved all correctness and authorization review findings through 52f25814; both final independent audits reported no blocker.

decisions.title: Treat deterministic evidence as the merge gate
decisions.rationale: The default-off reader, authorization, lifecycle, and three transport surfaces are fully exercised without depending on unacknowledged external services.

decisions.title: Keep production enablement resource-gated
decisions.rationale: Live Postgres/pgvector, embedding-provider, and retrieval-quality evidence must run against acknowledged scratch or deployment resources.

Run deferred Postgres/provider/retrieval-quality gates before production enablement.
